caption: The drawing displays two spoons, both rendered in shades of gray pencil on a beige or off-white background. The spoons are depicted horizontally and parallel to each other, with the bowls facing to the left and the handles extending toward the right. The upper spoon is shown from a top-down perspective, revealing its broad, oval-shaped bowl and slightly tapering handle that ends in a rounded tip. The lower spoon is shown from a similar angle but at a slightly different orientation, with additional stippling and shading indicating curvature and depth, and there is a small marking or engraving indicated on the handle. Below these two spoons, in the bottom right corner of the main drawing area, is a smaller inset diagram with dimensions labeled, displaying the outline and key measurements for the length and width of the spoon; this inset is drawn with thinner lines. The drawing is signed "C. Winter" in the lower right corner and notes a scale of ¾:1. There is a faint rectangular border framing the main drawing.
title: Silver Spoon
